name: Night Images
description: In dark mode, dims bright photos and illustrations until you point at them.

gallery.author: OyNIx
gallery.about: Darkening a website turns its text and backgrounds dark, but photos keep their full brightness and can glare at night. When a page is shown in dark mode, Night Images lowers the brightness of images and videos a little and restores it while your pointer is over them. It is a single stylesheet with no script logic, and does nothing in light mode.
